_scene: You are the cheerful narrator of a toddler's ambulance rescue video game, like an energetic rescue-team buddy talking to a 4-year-old. Playful, warm, energetic, clearly articulated, like a friendly kids' TV host. Short sentences with clear emotion.

s1.dir: Count 'Three... two... one...' slowly and clearly with a pause between each number, then burst out 'rescue time!' fast and super excited, rising pitch.

s2.text: Move side to side to change lanes!
s2.dir: Friendly and inviting, medium pace, sing-song 'side to side', rising intonation at the end.

s3.dir: Quick and alert like spotting something, a little gasp of concern but still upbeat, pitch rising on 'help'.

s4.dir: Big proud cheer, fast and bright, like celebrating a goal.

s5.dir: Warm and sweet, medium pace, smiling, relieved and proud.

s6.dir: Shout it like a superhero announcement, stretched 'Suuuper', big and fun.

s7.dir: Short admiring cheer, high energy, giggly at the end.

s8.dir: Delighted surprise on 'Sweet heart!', then fast and bouncy on 'Double points!'.

s9.dir: Dramatic and fun, stretched 'Maaagnet', then a punchy 'power!'.

s10.dir: Excited announcement on 'Power is full!', then an encouraging, clear instruction 'Hands up!' with rising pitch.

s11.dir: Gentle, patient and playful, medium pace, no pressure, smiling.

s12.text: Robot rescue mode! Go, go, go!
s12.dir: Slightly robotic-fun on 'Robot rescue mode!', then fast chanting 'Go, go, go!' each louder than the last.

s13.dir: A big explosive 'Boom!', then fast and triumphant.

s14.dir: Cheerful and a little out of breath like after a fun run, medium pace, happy.

s15.dir: A surprised 'Oops!', then giggling through 'Silly spin!', clearly laughing, not worried.

s16.dir: Reassuring and bouncy, quick, encouraging like cheering someone on.

s17.dir: Slow and proud on 'Five cars are safe!', then a huge joyful 'Hooray!' rising high.

s18.dir: Clear and firm but kind, slower pace, like a caring grown-up, slight pause before 'please'.

s19.dir: Relieved and bright, fast and happy, rising at the end.
